title: Analytics Service Observability: Golden Paths for SLIs/SLOs, Tracing, and Dashboards
creator: Ava Chen
description: Define a lightweight, repeatable set of "golden path" observability deliverables for all Console analytics backends and pipelines. This ticket captures standards for SLI/SLO definitions, tracing and span conventions, structured logging fields, and a minimal set of dashboards and alerts that must exist for any new analytics service we deploy. Goal: reduce onboarding friction for new services, make on-call handoffs predictable, and give product teams consistent reliability guarantees.
acceptance_criteria: 1) A published SLI/SLO template document with examples for request latency, processing latency, throughput, and error rate. 2) Tracing convention doc with required attributes and example spans for ingestion -> enrichment -> aggregation -> export. 3) A normalized structured-log schema and best-practices for log sampling and retention. 4) A recommended dashboard bundle (Grafana/Looker) with at least: service overview, latency histogram, pipeline lag, queue depth, error breakdown, and a cardinality check. 5) Alert runbook mappings for each SLO and a short on-call playbook. 6) Two analytics services (see ENG-15345, ENG-15346) onboarded using the golden path docs and a post-onboard retrospective showing reduced MTTR compared to baseline.
implementation_plan: Phase 1: Draft SLI/SLO templates and trace/span conventions (2 weeks). Phase 2: Define structured log schema and sample code snippets for Go/Node/Python SDKs (1 week). Phase 3: Assemble dashboard templates and alert rules, publish Grafana JSON and Looker explores (2 weeks). Phase 4: Pilot with two teams (ENG-15345, ENG-15346) and iterate based on feedback (2 weeks). Phase 5: Publish canonical docs in Confluence + add CI check that new analytics services include a 'observability checklist' in their PRs (1 week).
monitoring_signal_catalog: SLIs: request_success_rate, p95_processing_latency_ms, ingestion_lag_seconds, downstream_export_failure_rate. SLO examples: 99.9% request_success_rate (rolling 30d), p95_processing_latency < 500ms. Alert thresholds: SLI error budget burn > 50% in 24h; ingestion_lag_seconds > 60s sustained for 5m; queue_depth > critical threshold for 10m.
tracing_convention_summary: All analytics pipelines must propagate a single trace_id and include span tags: service, pipeline_stage (ingest|enrich|aggregate|export), dataset, tenant_id (if multi-tenant), request_type. Spans for expensive steps must record input_size_bytes and output_size_bytes. For batch processors include batch_id and item_count. Sampling: keep 100% for errors; adaptive sampling for successful traffic with head-based sampling and reservoir for long traces. Provide OpenTelemetry examples and SDK config snippets.
dashboards_examples: Bundle contains: (A) Service Overview: RPS, success rate, p50/p95/p99 latencies. (B) Pipeline Health: per-stage processing time, backlog/lag, last_processed_timestamp. (C) Resource & Cost: GPU/CPU utilization, memory pressure, token processing cost estimate. (D) Data Quality: rate of schema mismatches, parsing errors. Dashboards are published as Grafana jsonnet in repo 'infra/monitoring/console-analytics'.
rollout_plan: 1) Share draft docs with Platform, Product, and two pilot teams; gather feedback (1 week). 2) Pilot onboarding for ENG-15345 and ENG-15346 (2 weeks). 3) Iterate and finalize docs. 4) Add a lightweight CI gate: new analytics service PRs must include an 'Observability checklist' file or automated checklist item. 5) Host a 1-hour brown-bag training for backend and platform engineers on the golden paths.
risks_mitigation: Risk: Overly prescriptive patterns slow adoption. Mitigation: keep the golden path minimal (must-haves vs nice-to-haves) and provide code snippets. Risk: High-cardinality tags in logs/traces increase cost. Mitigation: document cardinality limits and examples of safe tagging; enforce via linting in SDKs. Risk: Dashboard maintenance burden. Mitigation: centralize canonical dashboard sources in infra repo and automate sync to Grafana.
notes: Progress: Initial draft completed; security reviewed tag patterns with Security team on 2025-08-22 (feedback applied). Trade-offs discussed: full 100% trace sampling vs adaptive sampling for cost — chose adaptive to balance debugging needs and storage. Follow-ups: add automated lint rule to reject 'tenant_id' logged as free-text without hashing for PII-sensitive customers.

Re-evaluate SLOs after 30 days of production data.
